title: 第9章 老狗等你许久了第10章 秦玄你自裁吧
content_zh:
武道一途，炼体为最基本，后是真武，真武境大成后，方是天罡境。
踏入天罡境，放眼整个清泉镇，都称得上是最顶尖一列的高手。
唯有几大家族的家主、长老才是这一级别的高手。
“走！”
眼见秦家三长老秦苍山出现，饶是秦玄也脸色一变，一言不发，很果断就直接身影闪烁，往外逃走。
毕竟他可是深知秦苍山身为三长老，乃秦家当今数一数二的高手，乃是天罡境的强大武修。
莫说是现在的秦玄，就算是当初丹田不曾被废的秦玄，也万万不是其对手。
“该死的，没想到这个老家伙居然也来了。”
秦玄本来面对秦星穹一人，自然还有几分抗衡的本钱，但秦苍山一来了，立刻就失去了，唯有逃命一途。
只是，秦苍山可是天罡境的强大武修，身影一动，便是瞬间横跨数丈之遥的距离，落在秦玄身后不足半丈距离。
一掌就是击向他的后背，掌劲凌厉，秦苍山冷漠道：“秦玄，如今你就算修为侥幸恢复了一些，但全盛时期的你尚且远不是老夫的对手，何况是现在，留下来吧。”
那一掌，玄光散射，蕴含着可怕的元力，远超在秦星穹之上，足以断金裂石，给予秦玄极大的致命危机感。
只是，太快了，他根本无法避开，只来得及转身以黑魔剑挡在身前。
轰！
如被蛮兽撞击，秦玄整个人倒飞开去，重重地击穿了一面墙壁，顿时尘烟四起，掩盖了他的身影。
“哼，就算借助秘法勉强恢复到了真武境又如何，终究只是暂时，远不及巅峰时期，何况与老夫斗。”
秦苍山冷哼一声，根本不曾将秦玄放在眼内，归根到底两者差距太大了。
“三长老真不愧是天罡境强者，果然厉害！”
秦星穹赞叹一声，对于提升实力越发地眼热。
秦玄虽然境界低，但好歹自己非但没能奈何，甚至还在其手上接连吃瘪了，归根到底还是没有绝对强大的实力。

如果像三长老这般，以高出一个大境界进行绝对压制，哪怕秦玄有着逆境伐上的诸般手段与技巧，也不行，照面间就被击飞了。
秦苍山颔首，道：“星穹，无需妄自菲薄，以你之姿，相信不出两年便可踏入天罡境，届时你便会感受到凌驾于真武境之上的强大了。”
两年？
秦星穹眼眸泛现一抹凌厉的血芒，以他的嗜血杀体，再配合一些手段，哪里需要两年那么久，最多一年，甚至半年，便可踏入天罡境了。
到时候，以他的体质与各种手段，莫说是三长老秦苍山，就算是目前秦家第一人的秦沧溟，也将不会是他的对手。
就在这时，两人都突兀察觉到不对劲之处，因为秦玄虽然被击飞了，但二人都相信那一掌不可能击杀秦玄，甚至难以真正重创对方，但秦玄身影迟迟不曾出现，顿时心感不妙，冲入破开的墙壁内。
秦苍山拂袖间大风刮起，尘烟散开，只见地上露出一个泥土四溅的大坑，却不见秦玄的身影。
两人顿时脸色一变，哪里还不明白，秦玄逃了！
“居然又被逃了！”
秦星穹又惊又怒，感觉自己一而再，再而三地被秦玄戏耍了，脸色很难看。
“好一个狡猾的小狐狸，不愧是昔日天星门的少主。”
秦苍山脸色阴沉，这个秦玄比起自己想象中还要狡猾，本以为那一掌创伤了对方，如今想来才知道，想必是秦玄藉此来逃走，而他们二人却蒙在鼓里。
虽然如今甚是不屑对方丹田被废，论为废物，但如此心机，依旧不得不让他为之佩服。
秦苍山冲天而起，落在不远处一栋五层高的屋檐，居高临下，将整个秦家大院收入眼内，要找出秦玄的身影。
然而，任由他如何搜寻，始终无法找出秦玄的身影。
“老夫明白了，秦灵儿那小丫头奄奄一息，秦玄肯定会寻找还神丹。
早前过来宝库肯定就是寻找还神丹，发现没有，现在肯定猜测就在老夫或者大长老那里。”
“大长老正在闭关，他不一定敢前往。
content_en:
In the first step of martial arts, physical training is the most basic, followed by true martial arts. After the true martial arts realm is completed, one can reach the Tiangang realm.
Stepping into the Tiangang Realm, looking at the entire Qingquan Town, they can be regarded as the top-notch masters.
Only the heads and elders of several major families are experts at this level.
"Let's go!"
Seeing the appearance of Qin Cangshan, the third elder of the Qin family, even Qin Xuan's expression changed. Without saying a word, he decisively ran away with his figure flashing.
After all, he knew very well that Qin Cangshan, as the third elder, was one of the top masters of the Qin family and a powerful martial artist in the Tiangang realm.
Not to mention the current Qin Xuan, even Qin Xuan who had not been destroyed in his Dantian back then was absolutely no match for him.
"Damn it, I didn't expect this old guy to come too."
Qin Xuan originally had some ability to compete against Qin Xingqiong, but when Qin Cangshan came, he immediately lost it and had no choice but to escape.
However, Qin Cangshan is a powerful martial artist in the Tiangang Realm. As soon as his figure moved, he instantly spanned a distance of several feet and landed less than half a foot behind Qin Xuan.
A palm hit him on the back with sharp force. Qin Cangshan said coldly: "Qin Xuan, even if your cultivation has recovered a little by chance, you were far from my opponent in your heyday, let alone now. Stay."
That palm, scattered with mysterious light, contained terrifying Yuan Power, which was far superior to Qin Xingqiong. It was enough to break gold and crack stones, giving Qin Xuan a great sense of fatal crisis.
However, it was too fast, and he couldn't avoid it at all. He only had time to turn around and block it in front of him with the Black Demon Sword.
boom!
Like being hit by a wild beast, Qin Xuan flew backwards and punched through a wall. Dust and smoke suddenly flew up, covering his figure.
"Hmph, so what if I can barely recover to the True Martial Realm with the help of secret techniques. After all, it is only temporary and far from the peak period, let alone fighting with me."
Qin Cangshan snorted coldly and never took Qin Xuan seriously. In the final analysis, the gap between the two was too big.
"The third elder is truly worthy of being a strong man in the Tiangang Realm, he is really powerful!"
Qin Xingqiong sighed in admiration, becoming more and more eager to improve his strength.
Although Qin Xuan was at a low level, not only was he unable to do anything, he even suffered defeats in his hands one after another. In the final analysis, he still did not have absolute strength.
If Qin Xuan, like the Third Elder, were to perform absolute suppression at a higher level, even if Qin Xuan had all the means and skills to fight against adversity, he would not be able to do it and he would be knocked away as soon as he came face to face with him.
Qin Cangshan nodded and said: "Xingqiong, there is no need to underestimate yourself. With your appearance, I believe that you will be able to step into the Tiangang Realm in less than two years. By then you will feel the power above the Zhenwu Realm."
Two years?
Qin Xingqiong's eyes flashed with a fierce blood light. With his bloodthirsty body-killing and some methods, it would not take as long as two years, at most one year, or even half a year, to enter the Tiangang realm.
By then, with his physique and various methods, not to mention the third elder Qin Cangshan, even Qin Cangming, the current number one member of the Qin family, will not be his opponent.
At this moment, both of them suddenly realized something was wrong, because although Qin Xuan was knocked away, they both believed that it was impossible to kill Qin Xuan with that palm, or even to seriously injure the other party. However, Qin Xuan's figure never appeared, and they suddenly felt bad and rushed into the broken wall.
A strong wind blew in Qin Cang Mountain's sleeves, and the dust and smoke dispersed, revealing a large pit with splashes of mud on the ground, but Qin Xuan's figure was nowhere to be seen.
The expressions of the two people suddenly changed. They didn't understand why Qin Xuan had escaped!
"He actually escaped again!"
Qin Xingqiong was shocked and angry. He felt that he had been tricked by Qin Xuan again and again, and his face looked ugly.
"What a cunning little fox. He is worthy of being the former young master of Tianxing Sect."
Qin Cangshan's face was gloomy. This Qin Xuan was more cunning than he thought. He thought that the palm of his hand hurt the opponent, but now that he thought about it, he realized that Qin Xuan must have borrowed it.They came to escape, but the two of them were kept in the dark.
Although he now despises the other party for having his Dantian destroyed and calling him a waste, he still has to admire him for such scheming.
Qin Cang Mountain soared into the sky and landed on the eaves of a five-story building not far away. From a high position, it took the entire Qin family compound into view, trying to find Qin Xuan's figure.
However, no matter how hard he searched, he could never find Qin Xuan.
"I understand, that little girl Qin Ling'er is dying, Qin Xuan will definitely look for the rejuvenation pill.
When I came to the treasure house earlier, I must have been looking for the God-Returning Pill. I found that it was not there. Now I must be guessing that it is with me or the great elder. "
“The Great Elder is in retreat, and he may not dare to go there.
